notes.notes:

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Early Access improvements & Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're excited to announce that Bullet Noir will leave Early Access with the release of version 1.0 on Wednesday, September 10, 2025!

In our brand-new fourth devlog, we detail the improvements and additions made in preparation for this milestone and since the Early Access launch, including the introduction of a brand-new Chapter 5, an enhanced arcade mode and speedrun options for all four characters, as well as technical upgrades, overhauled graphics and cinematics, a refined UI, and additional languages.


Check it out:[previewyoutube="6F88OwY5xyk;full"][/previewyoutube]








Play the Demo and buy Bullet Noir to get ready for 1.0!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Early Access Update 6
notes.notes:
Our final Early Access update, arriving before the 1.0 launch, is packed with new content and polish!

[hr][/hr]
Here’s what’s new:

Revenge now speaks your language! 

Added full localization for Italian, French, German, and Spanish languages.

4 new Arcade Mode levels

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/6c56d321e083876ac8c5d2e09de01e49160c756b.png"]

Take on brand-new challenges and uncover the stories behind them:

Dark Waters, Healthcare Part 2, Bridge, and Resolution Part 1.

Enhanced cinematics for a more immersive story.

UI/UX improvements for smoother navigation.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/bc584a8ec461938ce5970a6c1f65ff9ba71b0f2c.png"]

Overall graphics enhancements across all levels.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/15a21dfa505875a6d1ab3518e2374eee940e566b.png"]

Improved enemy behavior to keep you on your toes.


[hr][/hr]
Once again, thank you for walking this dark, vengeful road with us. 

The 1.0 launch is right around the corner. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Early Access Update #5 – v0.9.1 Is Live
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Our fifth major Early Access update is here, and it’s all about speed, precision, and fresh challenges.
[hr][/hr]🕒 New Mode: Speedrun
Speedrun Mode is now available.

No cutscenes, no intermissions, just pure gameplay and a ticking clock. Set your best time and climb the brand-new Speedrun leaderboards. 

Note: Speedrun Mode unlocks after completing the first Story Mode level (The Nest). This is a temporary setup and will be streamlined in the future.
[hr][/hr]🗺️ Four New Story Mode Levels
We’ve expanded the campaign with one new level per chapter, all fully playable in both Story and Speedrun Modes:

Chapter 1: Dark Waters

Chapter 2: Healthcare Part 2

Chapter 3: Bridge

Chapter 4: Resolution Part 1

We recommend starting a fresh save file to ensure clean progression with the latest content.
[hr][/hr]🏆 Bullet Noir is a Collision Awards Finalist
We’re proud to announce that Bullet Noir is a finalist in two categories at the 2025 Collision Awards.

You can help us win. Cast your votes here:

 Vote for Best in Style  Vote for Best in Craft

Thanks for being part of this journey and helping us get here.
[hr][/hr]☀️ Steam Summer Sale – 20% Off Until July 10
Bullet Noir is now 20% off as part of the Steam Summer Sale.

If you’ve been waiting to dive in, now’s the time.
Experience the new Speedrun Mode, take on fresh levels, and see how far you can climb.

We’ve got more updates on the way. Until then, thank you for your support and feedback.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Early Access Update #4 – Patch 0.8.9 is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Arcade Mode Expands. New Blades Hit the Streets.

Hey everyone,

Our fourth Early Access update for Bullet Noir is officially live! This update brings more slicing, more scoring, and even more ways to rise the leaderboards.
[hr][/hr]⚔️ The Lady Joins Arcade Mode
Wield the katana and carve a path through the chaos.
The Lady is now playable in Arcade Mode. Use her unique skills to cut down enemies in style and chase vengeance your way.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/fe725733cd315761ac3afa7bf0a3799c6df67de5.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/5b5fdc3638b10c372b237822460567cc4321eb45.png"]
[hr][/hr]📊 Global Leaderboards Now Include Arcade Mode
You asked, we delivered.

Every Arcade Mode level now supports global and friends-only leaderboards

Compete with any character, on any level

Show off your high scores and compare your runs with the rest of the world

🛈 Note: Arcade Mode levels may have slight differences from their Story Mode versions. Adapt accordingly.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/c64377c4eb4c417bc4d92833416016a2043f80eb.png"]
[hr][/hr]🆕 2025 Content Roadmap
Thank you for continuing to play, share, and support Bullet Noir. Your feedback keeps pushing us forward, and there's more to come in 2025!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/f295be4d6a7918cb49f0d93fe89731b8e5cd6ca3.png"]
[hr][/hr]🎧 ICYMI: The Official Soundtrack is Out Now
Step into the world of Bullet Noir anytime with our original soundtrack, featuring 16 tracks by composer Cosmin Mirza (Door Kickers 2, Trinity Fusion).
Whether you're playing or just vibing, it's the perfect background for vengeance.

🎵 Available on Steam and YouTube

notes.title: Bullet Noir - Early Access Update #1
notes.notes:
Our first Early Access update for Bullet Noir is live! 

Here’s what’s new under the flickering streetlights and constant rain:

 Arcade Mode is now unlocked for the Doctor. It's time to test your skills.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/a41cc02f3e2b50eee4792cadb21b449079d23a9a.png
 Cinematics have been sharpened with new voice-overs and richer visuals, pulling you deeper into the shadows.
 A new Mini-Boss prowls the alleys: a fast-moving, close-quarters bruiser. Drop them with 2 pistol shots, 1 shotgun blast, or a melee strike... if you’re quick enough.
 Loading Screen Tips were added to keep you sharp between runs.
 The Menu and Score Screen got a fresh coat of paint: slicker, sharper, and ready for business.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/47f24c3fab88c83c09e542e963ee0f80be7a3ed4.png

Thank you for playing and supporting us! Stay tuned, more updates are on the way!
